definitions.explanation: A calculated central value of a set of numbers; or the typical amount or level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均|へいきん}⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The average lifespan of Japanese people is long.

notes:
USAGE: {平均|へいきん} is used both for mathematical averages and general typical values.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {平均|へいきん}する (to average)
- {平均|へいきん}して (on average)
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}{的|てき}→平均的：21895_heikinteki⟧な (average, typical)
- {平均|へいきん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧/⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧ (above/below average)

COMPOUNDS:
- {平均|へいきん}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (average score)
- {平均|へいきん}⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧ (average temperature)
- {平均|へいきん}⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧ (average lifespan)
- {平均|へいきん}⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧ (average age)
- {平均|へいきん}⟦{値|ち}→値：21704_atai⟧ (average value)
